% Fixture for BUG-18: version package \excludeversion stripped by
% build_minimal_preamble.
%
% The version package defines environments via \includeversion{name} (shows
% content) and \excludeversion{name} (hides content). These calls must
% remain in the preamble for the named environments (e.g., "invisible") to
% work. build_minimal_preamble strips everything that is not \documentclass,
% \usepackage, \usetikzlibrary, \newtheorem, or front-matter. When
% \excludeversion{invisible} is stripped, \begin{invisible}...\end{invisible}
% in the body fails with:
% "! LaTeX Error: \begin{document} ended by \end{invisible}."
%
% Playground verified: with \usepackage{version} + \excludeversion{invisible},
% \begin{invisible}hidden\end{invisible} compiles fine.
% Without \excludeversion{invisible}: compile error.
%
% Paper 2602.08954 (seeds 3 and 6) triggers this.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{version}
\excludeversion{invisible}
\begin{document}
\begin{invisible}
This content should be hidden.
\end{invisible}
Visible content.
\end{document}
